title: The bakery
paragraphs: Mr Tan’s bakery had been losing customers for months. A new supermarket sold {{1}} bread, and many people stopped coming. Instead of giving up, he decided to make something the supermarket could not: {{2}} buns from his mother’s old recipe.
The smell {{3}} down the street every morning. Soon people were {{4}} outside before the doors opened. Mr Tan had to {{5}} two more bakers.
